displayName: MTH OTHER realm (SYNTHETIC; a foreign issuer whose tokens the hub must refuse)

attributes.mth.notice: NEGATIVE-TEST realm for the Mobily Transformation Hub (ADR-0054 §1, REQ-S16-007). The hub is configured for realm mth-test only; this realm exists so the e2e can prove that an authorization response and ID token from ANOTHER realm of the same server are refused (/login?error=token_invalid, no session). It deliberately reuses the client id mth-hub and the same client-secret placeholder, so the only differences are the issuer and the realm's own signing keys. Every user is SYNTHETIC; no real people, no real credentials. Secrets are injected at start from environment placeholders and are never stored in this file. Never configure the hub against this realm.

clients.name: Mobily Transformation Hub (foreign-realm negative test)
clients.description: Same client id as realm mth-test on purpose: a matching client id must not be enough for the hub to accept a token from another issuer.
